                             CITY OF NORWALK 
                    NORWALK SHELLFISH COMMISSION 
                  REGULAR MEETING – NOVEMBER 5, 2026 
                       VIA ZOOM VIRTUAL MEETING 
 
                                        
ATTENDANCE:   Steve Bartush (Chair), Jonathan Pageler, Pete Johnson, Nick Sacchinelli.  
 
STAFF:            Kyle Bader, Housing Inspector. 
 
OTHERS:           Jeff Mangels, Harbor Management Commission; Kelly Bloom, Harbor 
                  Management Commission; Geoff Steadman, Consultant; Sgt. Justin 
                  Bisceglie. 
 
   I.    CALL TO ORDER 
          
      Mr. Bartush called the meeting to order at 6:31 pm. A quorum was present. 
 
   II.   ROLL CALL 
                                        
      A roll call of those present was performed. 
                                        
   III.  ACCEPTANCE OF MINUTES 
                                        
      A. REGULAR MEETING: OCTOBER 1, 2026 
                                        
         **MR. PAGELER MOVED TO APPROVE THE MINUTES. 
         **MR. SACCHINELLI SECONDED THE MOTION. 
         **THE MOTION PASSED UNANIMOUSLY. 
 
   IV.   PUBLIC PARTICIPATION 
                                        
      There was no public participation.  
    
   V.    REPORTS 
                                        
      A. TREASURER 
                                        
      Mr. Bader noted no changes to expenditures for October. The balance remains at $34,912. 
 
      B. SECRETARY 
 
      There was no report.

      C. HEALTH DEPARTMENT 
          
      Mr. Bader reported 2.08 inches of rainfall, compared to 3.58 inches in 2025 and a historical 
      average of 4.44 inches. One closure occurred on October 12 due to rainfall exceeding 1.6 
      inches. No bypasses were reported. 
 
      D. WASTEWATER TREATMENT PLANT 
                                        
      There was no report. 
 
      E. WATER QUALITY 
 
      There was no report. 
 
      F. PERMITS 
 
      Mr. Bader advised there has been no change. Mr. Mooney confirmed to him there were 
      no permits. 
 
      G. POLICE 
 
      Sgt. Bisceglie reported water temperatures ranging from 58–60°F. 
 
      H. ADVISORY 
 
      Mr. Steadman provided updates on Manresa Island remediation and potential impacts to 
      surrounding shellfish beds, noting that further clarification from DEEP is pending. He 
      discussed a sewage discharge in Stamford Harbor, where shellfish beds have reopened, 
      although DEEP continues to await a detailed incident report. He also noted efforts in 
      Stamford and Greenwich to strengthen shellfish protections through harbor management 
      plans and expressed concern over limited participation in the Norwalk River Watershed 
      Initiative, with its updated plan still under EPA review. 
       
      Mr. Johnson shared concern over docks, moorings, and development impacting historically 
      protected shellfish grounds. 
 
      I. HARBOR MANAGEMENT 
 
      Mr. Mangels reported that the Harbor Management Commission reviewed zoning referrals 
      #2026-68R and #2026-70R, finding the first consistent with the Harbor Management Plan 
      and the second inconsistent due to proposed non-water-dependent uses. The Commission 
      also found proposed improvements at 7 Twilight Place consistent with the Plan. He 
      highlighted an October 24 cleanup of Grassy Island by Boy Scout Troop 222 and

      planned. No new dock or seawall applications or water quality updates were reported. 
 
         **MR. SACCHINELLI MOVED TO ACCEPT THE COMMITTEE 
         REPORTS. 
         **MR. PAGELER SECONDED THE MOTION. 
         **THE MOTION PASSED UNANIMOUSLY. 
 
   VI.   OLD BUSINESS 
          
      There was no old business discussed. 
 
   VII.  NEW BUSINESS 
 
      There was no new business discussed. 
          
   VIII. DISCUSSION 
 
      Mr. Mangels suggested organizing a joint holiday gathering for the Harbor Management 
      and Shellfish Commissions. 
 
   IX.   ADJOURNMENT 
          
         **MR. SACCHINELLI MOVED TO ADJOURN. 
         **MR. PAGELER SECONDED THE MOTION. 
         **THE MOTION PASSED UNANIMOUSLY. 
          
                           UPCOMING MEETINGS 
                               
                              December 3, 2026. 
          
The meeting adjourned at 6:52 pm.
